// Helper to create thumbnails (for images only)
function createThumbnail($filePath, $thumbPath, $maxDim = 120) {
    if (!file_exists($thumbPath)) {
        list($width, $height, $type) = getimagesize($filePath);
        $ratio = $width/$height;

        if ($ratio > 1) {
            $newWidth = $maxDim;
            $newHeight = $maxDim / $ratio;
        } else {
            $newWidth = $maxDim * $ratio;
            $newHeight = $maxDim;
        }

        $src = null;
        switch ($type) {
            case IMAGETYPE_JPEG:
                $src = imagecreatefromjpeg($filePath);
                break;
            case IMAGETYPE_PNG:
                $src = imagecreatefrompng($filePath);
                break;
            default:
                return false;
        }

        $dst = imagecreatetruecolor($newWidth, $newHeight);
        // Preserve transparency for PNG
        if ($type == IMAGETYPE_PNG) {
            imagealphablending($dst, false);
            imagesavealpha($dst,true);
            $transparent = imagecolorallocatealpha($dst, 255, 255, 255, 127);
            imagefilledrectangle($dst, 0, 0, $newWidth, $newHeight, $transparent);
        }

        imagecopyresampled($dst, $src, 0,0,0,0, $newWidth, $newHeight, $width, $height);
        imagepng($dst, $thumbPath);
        imagedestroy($src);
        imagedestroy($dst);
        return true;
    }
    return true; // already exists
}

function humanFilesize($bytes, $decimals = 2) {
    $sz = 'BKMGTP';
    $factor = floor((strlen($bytes) - 1) / 3);
    return sprintf("%.{$decimals}f", $bytes / pow(1024, $factor)) . @$sz[$factor];
}

// Logout
if (isset($_GET['logout'])) {
    session_destroy();
    header('Location: index.php');
    exit;
}

    foreach ($files as $file) {
        $filePath = $folderPath . '/' . $file;
        if (!is_file($filePath)) continue;

        $fileExt = strtolower(pathinfo($file, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
        $fileUrl = $baseUrl . '/' . $folder . '/' . rawurlencode($file);
        $fileSize = humanFilesize(filesize($filePath));
        $fileMod = date("Y-m-d H:i", filemtime($filePath));

        // Thumbnail path
        $thumbDir = $baseDir . '/.thumbs/' . $folder;
        if (!is_dir($thumbDir)) mkdir($thumbDir, 0755, true);
        $thumbPath = $thumbDir . '/' . $file . '.png';

        $thumbUrl = $baseUrl . '/.thumbs/' . $folder . '/' . rawurlencode($file) . '.png';

        $thumbCreated = false;

        if (in_array($fileExt, ['jpg','jpeg','png'])) {
            $thumbCreated = createThumbnail($filePath, $thumbPath);
        } elseif ($fileExt === 'pdf') {
            // Optional: Generate PDF thumbnails with imagick if installed (skip here)
            $thumbCreated = false;
        }

        echo "<tr>";
        echo "<td>";
        if ($thumbCreated && file_exists($thumbPath)) {
            echo "<img src='$thumbUrl' alt='Thumbnail' class='thumb'>";
        } else {
            echo "<span style='font-size:14px;color:#999;'>No preview</span>";
        }
        echo "</td>";
        echo "<td><a href='$fileUrl' target='_blank'>" . htmlspecialchars($file) . "</a></td>";
        echo "<td>$fileSize</td>";
        echo "<td>$fileMod</td>";
        echo "<td>" . htmlspecialchars($folder) . "</td>";
        echo "<td><a href='qrcode_generator.php?file=" . urlencode($folder . '/' . $file) . "' target='_blank' class='btn-qr'>View QR</a></td>";
        echo "</tr>";
    }

    echo "</tbody></table>";
    echo "</section>";
}
?>

</main>

</body>
</html>

Notes:

  • This page shows each allowed folder’s files in a table.

  • Image thumbnails are generated and cached in .thumbs/[folder]/filename.png.

  • Clicking “View QR” opens the QR code page for that file.

  • Logout button ends the session and redirects to login page.

To fix this:

  1. Open your index.php file.

  2. Search for any lines that echo or print those messages (like echo "Trying login with username: ...").

  3. Remove or comment out those echo/debug lines entirely.

  4. Make sure no output is sent before the header('Location: dashboard.php') line.

Important:

In PHP, if you output anything (even spaces or messages) before calling header(), the redirect won’t work. That’s why removing those debug messages is critical.

        $_SESSION['username'] = $username;

    }
}
